name: blobatar
//exports: Shim for git-dependency consumers: `bun add git+https://github.com/AdamOusmer/blobatar` resolves package identity from THIS root package.json, not packages/blobatar/package.json — a git dependency has no npm registry entry to read a nested workspace member's manifest from. Forwards each subpath straight into the workspace member's TS source, so a consumer gets the same framework-agnostic, source-only package `packages/blobatar` itself ships. Kept in sync with packages/blobatar/package.json's own `exports`.

scripts.//api: The library build first, both here and in `deploy:api`. `apps/api` resolves `blobatar` through its `exports` map — built JS that is not in the repo — so unlike the site, which aliases the library to source, it cannot start against a fresh clone.
scripts.api: bun --filter blobatar build && bun --filter blobatar-api dev
scripts.deploy:api: bun --filter blobatar build && bun --filter blobatar-api deploy
